description:
Because:

- fxa-shared/tracing and @fxa/shared/otel held two copies of the same tracing code.
- profile-server was the last service on the fxa-shared copy.

This commit:

- Makes fxa-shared/tracing config.ts and node-tracing.ts re-export @fxa/shared/otel.
- Deletes the fxa-shared tracing PII filter, exporters and mocha tests.
- Ports the config, exporters and batchProcessor tests to Jest in libs/shared/otel.
- Keeps the profile-server otel concurrencyLimit default at 10, with a spec.

Closes FXA-10674
